G13.split: (a) elementary types, literals, units and exact constants; (b) conversions and implicit widening; (c) aggregate and data-location typing; (d) overload selection and UDVT operators; (e) function/ABI metadata typing; then the static-semantics certificate

G15.split: one admission lemma per manifest category (12), each proving exact classification of its rows; a combination lemma for the named and ledger-symbol combinations; an exclusion lemma refusing the 30 excluded IDs (D01); then extraction coverage over all execution roots

G47.split: (a) CALL/STATICCALL frames, returndata and the frame-failure rule (D19); (b) CREATE and initcode installation; (c) REVERT and persistent/transient/balance rollback; (d) transactions, sender funds (D21) and gas-exhaustion failures (D20); (e) precompiles (D22); compose under the resource abstraction

G48.split: (a) admission → resolved graph; (b) resolved → intrinsic per area: declarations, expressions/statements, aggregates, world/calls; (c) whole-unit coverage over compilation units; each a `Cert` composed by `Cert.comp`

G46.01.split: (a) arithmetic, comparison and bitwise opcodes (seed: `ExternalEvm.simulation`); (b) signedness, narrow truncation and casts; (c) PUSH constants and control primitives JUMP/JUMPI/JUMPDEST

G46.02.split: (a) MLOAD/MSTORE/MSTORE8 against the byte-addressed representation; (b) CALLDATALOAD/CALLDATACOPY against the calldata representation; (c) memory expansion and its resource bound; (d) RETURN/REVERT byte ranges

G49.01.split: one composition lemma per pass family: expressions, statements/control, calls and frames, aggregates and copies, world and ABI; then their `Cert.comp` with the closure hypotheses

G49.02.split: (a) runtime refinement per deployed contract; (b) observation mapping incl. return/revert bytes and panics (D13); (c) the `decode` export (D14); (d) threading the per-run hash premise (D11); (e) the EvalOrder quantifier (D04)

G49.03.split: (a) compiler totality on admitted input; (b) non-vacuity controls (success with data, revert, divergence); (c) failure preservation (no always-revert); (d) resource-indexed progress and finite-prefix families

G51.01.split: one soundness bridge per rule family: storage, memory, control/loops, internal calls, external calls/callbacks, arithmetic/checked guards; each against the composed runtime theorem
